name: Turkey Parmesan Meatball Bake
ingredients_verbatim: 16 ounces low carb homemade marinara sauce
2 tablespoons fresh herbs (basil or parsley) for serving
rebuild_note: SOURCE PROTEIN IS GROUND CHICKEN - rebuilt on GROUND TURKEY per the standing no-ground-chicken rule. Ground turkey (93%) macros track ground chicken closely, so the published 466 cal / 35 g protein / 9 g carb basis holds under the swap. The optional ground almonds + olive oil are for the fry variant only and are DROPPED for the oven-bake path (bake meatballs 25 min, then add sauce + mozzarella and bake to melt).
unmapped: marinara sauce (may need a board home vs. canned tomatoes/tomato sauce)
why: Fills a real gap: the turkey-meatball dishes already in the pool are all skillet/cream-sauce, Greek-feta, jalapeno-popper or Swedish - there is NO turkey meatball PARMESAN bake, and this is a clean oven-only version (bake meatballs, blanket with marinara + mozzarella, bake to melt). PUBLISHED nutrition lands dead-center of the band at 466 cal / 35 g protein / 9 g total carb (7 g net) / 33 g fat per serving on a 4-serving basis - high protein relative to calories and comfortably clear of both the 400 floor and the 35 g carb ceiling with our compute-drift cushion. Structurally low-carb (meatballs + marinara + cheese, no pasta/rice/bread base). Batch-scalable: form meatballs, bake in sheet/9x13 pans, weigh-and-divide; multiply x3.5 for 14 servings. Proves the rebuild path (ground chicken -> ground turkey) for the pricer lane.
confidence: high on numbers - read directly from the published recipe card (466 cal / 35 g protein / 9 g total carb / 33 g fat). One caveat: nutrition is calculated on ground chicken; the ground-turkey rebuild shifts it only marginally.
